description: Generic OData query against any dataset in the OpenFEMA dataset catalog — the escape hatch for datasets the convenience tools do not cover (e.g., NfipPolicies, IndividualAssistanceHousingRegistrantsLargeDisasters, FemaWebDeclarationAreas, PublicAssistanceApplicants). Accepts raw OData filter, select, orderby, and pagination parameters. For NfipPolicies, use propertyState (not state) for the state and reportedZipCode for the ZIP code — it has no countyCode; always include a ZIP filter to avoid timeout. The dataset name must match the exact OpenFEMA entity name (case-sensitive, e.g., NfipClaims). Names missing from the catalog return an unknown_dataset error; a listed dataset OpenFEMA does not serve through the API returns dataset_not_served.

dataset.description: OpenFEMA dataset entity name (case-sensitive, e.g., NfipPolicies, FemaWebDeclarationAreas, PublicAssistanceApplicants).

filter.description: OData $filter expression (e.g., "state eq 'TX' and declarationDate ge '2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'"). String values in single quotes.

name: fema_query_dataset

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_dataset`: The dataset name is not in the OpenFEMA dataset catalog. `dataset_not_served`: The OpenFEMA dataset catalog lists the dataset, but OpenFEMA answers its API endpoint with a 404 page. `catalog_unavailable`: The OpenFEMA dataset catalog could not be read, so the dataset API version is unknown. `invalid_filter`: OpenFEMA rejected the filter expression — an unknown field, a value of the wrong type or range, or unparseable syntax. `invalid_select`: OpenFEMA rejected the select list — an unknown field or unparseable syntax. `invalid_orderby`: OpenFEMA rejected the orderby expression — an unknown field or unparseable syntax. `invalid_odata_syntax`: OpenFEMA could not parse the request and did not say whether filter, select, or orderby was at fault. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance on an empty page — filter advice when nothing matches, or the total and last valid offset when offset is at or past the end.

returned_count.description: Number of records in this response.

rows.description: Records returned from the dataset. Field names depend on the queried dataset.

items.description: A single record from the queried dataset. Field names and types vary by dataset.

totalCount.description: Total matching records before pagination — exceeds returned_count when results were capped at the limit.

title: Query Any OpenFEMA Dataset
